meta.subject: L1Tagaccess flush dirty cycle missmatch fixed

en.summary: This commit fixes a one-cycle alignment bug in L1TagAccess flush handling by delaying the chosen dirty-way mask to match the cycle when the tag SRAM response becomes valid.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly describes a flush dirty cycle mismatch.
The change is in L1TagAccess flush logic that selects the dirty line to evict or flush.
The patch corrects a classic synchronous-memory alignment problem between a selector and the returned data.
evidence: choosenDirtyWayMask_st1 is added as a RegNext of choosenDirtyWayMask_st0.
choosenDirtyTag_st1 changes from indexing tagBodyAccess.io.r.resp.data with choosenDirtyWayMask_st0 to using choosenDirtyWayMask_st1.
Nearby code already uses staged dirty set and ASID signals, showing the flush path is pipeline-sensitive.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Flush and eviction logic often selects a dirty way in one cycle and reads the corresponding tag RAM in the next cycle. The way selector and the SRAM response must therefore be in the same pipeline stage. If the design indexes a cycle-late tag response with a cycle-early way mask, it can pair the wrong tag with the selected dirty line and generate an incorrect writeback or flush address.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: selector-to-SRAM-response pipeline alignment for dirty-line flush
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The cache scans for dirty lines, selects a victim or flush target, and reads tag metadata from a synchronous array with at least one cycle of latency.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Use the current-cycle dirty-way selector directly on the next-cycle tag-array response instead of delaying the selector to match the response latency.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: omit one-cycle delay on selector that indexes synchronous memory output
portability_notes: This bug generalizes to any selector/data pair where the selector is produced before a synchronous metadata read returns.
Apply it to dirty-line flush, victim selection, or replacement metadata paths that compute an address from returned tag data.
The most faithful reinjection preserves the dirty-set selection logic and only removes the selector delay.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that chooses a dirty way or victim way before reading tag metadata from SRAM.
Remove the pipeline register that delays the chosen way mask or index into the cycle of the tag response.
Index the returned tag array with the early selector directly.
Keep the rest of the flush or eviction path unchanged.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: dirty flush way selection and dirty tag lookup around choosenDirtyWayMask_st0/st1
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix registers choosenDirtyWayMask_st0 into choosenDirtyWayMask_st1 and uses the delayed mask to select tagBodyAccess.io.r.resp.data for dirtyTag_st1.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Commit b16761ff adds choosenDirtyWayMask_st1 := RegNext(choosenDirtyWayMask_st0) and replaces choosenDirtyWayMask_st0 with choosenDirtyWayMask_st1 in the dirty tag lookup.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The flush or eviction path can form the wrong physical address for a dirty line, causing misdirected writeback, missed flushes, or corruption when a different line is treated as dirty victim data.
evidence_for_injection: The only functional change is a one-cycle delay added to the dirty-way selector before indexing a tag SRAM response.
The commit message directly identifies a cycle mismatch.
Neighboring signals such as dirtySetIdx and dirtyASID are already staged, confirming a pipelined metadata path.
notes: This is a textbook pipeline-alignment bug and is highly reusable across cache metadata paths.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 L1TagAccess 在 flush 路径上的单周期对齐错误：被选中的脏 way mask 需要延迟到 tag SRAM 响应有效的那个周期再使用。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确描述了 flush dirty 的周期错位。
修改位于 L1TagAccess 中选择脏行进行驱逐或 flush 的逻辑。
补丁修复的是同步存储器常见的“选择信号与返回数据不同拍”问题。
evidence: 新增了 choosenDirtyWayMask_st1，作为 choosenDirtyWayMask_st0 的 RegNext。
choosenDirtyTag_st1 从用 choosenDirtyWayMask_st0 索引 tagBodyAccess.io.r.resp.data，改成使用 choosenDirtyWayMask_st1。
邻近代码本来就对 dirty set 和 ASID 做了分拍处理，说明 flush 路径是典型的流水式元数据通路。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: flush 或驱逐逻辑经常会在一个周期里选出脏 way，并在下一个周期读取对应的 tag RAM。这样一来，way 选择信号和 SRAM 返回值必须处于同一个流水级。如果设计拿当前周期的 way mask 去索引下一周期才返回的 tag 数据，就会把错误的 tag 与选中的脏行配对，从而生成错误的写回或 flush 地址。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: selector-to-SRAM-response pipeline alignment for dirty-line flush
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: cache 在扫描脏行、选择 victim 或 flush 目标，并从至少一拍延迟的同步 tag array 中读取元数据。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 直接用当前周期的脏 way 选择信号去索引下一周期的 tag-array 响应，而不是把选择信号延迟到与响应对齐。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: omit one-cycle delay on selector that indexes synchronous memory output
portability_notes: 该 bug 可推广到任何“选择信号先产生、同步元数据后返回”的 selector/data 配对。
可以映射到脏行 flush、victim 选择或依赖返回 tag 数据计算地址的替换元数据路径。
最贴近原修复的重新注入方式，是保留脏 set 选择逻辑，只去掉 selector 的那一级延迟。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到在读取 tag 元数据之前选择脏 way 或 victim way 的逻辑。
删除把该选择信号延迟到 tag 响应周期的流水寄存器。
直接用提前一个周期的 selector 去索引返回的 tag array。
保持其余 flush/驱逐路径不变。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 围绕 choosenDirtyWayMask_st0/st1 的脏行 flush way 选择与 dirty tag 查找
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 choosenDirtyWayMask_st0 寄存到 choosenDirtyWayMask_st1，并用延迟后的 mask 去选择 tagBodyAccess.io.r.resp.data，得到 dirtyTag_st1。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 提交 b16761ff 新增了 choosenDirtyWayMask_st1 := RegNext(choosenDirtyWayMask_st0)，并在 dirty tag 查找里用它替换了 choosenDirtyWayMask_st0。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: flush 或驱逐路径可能为脏行形成错误的物理地址，导致写回打到错误地址、flush 漏刷，或把另一条 line 错当成脏 victim。
evidence_for_injection: 唯一的功能改动，就是在用来索引 tag SRAM 响应的脏 way 选择信号前增加了一拍延迟。
提交信息直接指出是周期错位。
dirtySetIdx 和 dirtyASID 等邻近信号本来就已经分拍，说明这是典型的流水元数据路径。
notes: 这是教科书式的流水对齐错误，非常适合跨 DUT 复用。
